subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up (BrightLayer)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rios <alex.rios@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up (BrightLayer) — post-call recap

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

Summary of what you shared:
- Primary use cases: customer support triage (chat/assist) + semantic search and personalization (embeddings) + occasional reranking for search results.
- Monthly active users: ~18k, peak concurrency expected ~80 concurrent chats.
- Expected token profile: chat sessions ~600 tokens average per session; embeddings calls are smaller (single vector per request, ~256 tokens per doc), rerank requests are high-token but low volume.
- Current vendor costs are high and unpredictable — procurement asked for target unit economics before procurement/ops will sign off.

Requests from our side (items we need to finalize pricing):
1) Confirm monthly token volumes by model type (rough ballpark OK): chat, embeddings, rerank. Please put a low/target/high if possible.
2) Target budget range for inference (monthly). You mentioned mid-range ~$10k-$25k/mo; want to confirm whether that was per environment or total.
3) SLA/latency targets and whether Dedicated capacity is required upfront or later.

Initial pricing guidance to discuss internally:
- Customers commonly target $/1M tokens in the $60–$120 range for mixed chat+embedding workloads depending on model mix and SLA.
- For model mix, cost sensitivity: chat (most tokens), embeddings (higher per-op cost per vector but lower tokens), rerank (few ops but expensive per op).

Proposed model mix to validate with you (we can adjust):
- Chat (chat-completions): 70% of total token volume
- Embeddings: 25% of calls (small token share but higher per-op cost)
- Rerank: 5% of calls (small volume)

Attached a mutual action plan and our call notes. Next steps:
- Alex: send rough monthly token volumes split by model (low/target/high) — reply to this thread.
- Marissa/Rishi: we will return a 90-day cost model and a target $/1M tokens mid-range number by EOD Tuesday.
- Schedule follow-up technical deep-dive (30–45 min) to validate concurrency and KV/cache opportunities.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, BrightLayer_Product_Requirements_v2.pdf

From: Alex Rios <alex.rios@brightlayer.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlayer.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up (BrightLayer)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick numbers from our side (rough estimates):
- Monthly active tokens (target): low 120M tokens / mo, target 320M tokens / mo, high 680M tokens / mo.
- Model split (by request volume): chat 68%, embeddings 27%, rerank 5% (rough). For token share, chat will account for ~92% of tokens due to completion length.
- Budget: procurement asked us to aim for <= $30k/mo as an upper bound for year 1 while we scale. The $10k–$25k earlier was for an initial pilot environment only.
- SLA: sub-300ms tail preferred for chat — can discuss whether dedicated is required.

A few questions:
1) Can you provide a target $/1M tokens for our model mix (ballpark) so we can run internal approval?
2) How much of a discount is typically available as we commit to reserved capacity?

Happy to join the technical deep-dive next week.

Best,
Alex
Head of Engineering | BrightLayer
alex.rios@brightlayer.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Model mix & pricing follow-up (BrightLayer) — pricing ask

Team — forwarding BrightLayer's estimates. They want a mid-range $/1M tokens for the model mix and guidance on reserved capacity economics. Action items:
- Rishi: please draft a 3-tier pricing scenario (pilot, mid, committed) with $/1M tokens, assumed model mix (chat/embeddings/rerank), and expected monthly totals. Include both hosted and Dedicated pricing buckets.
- Priyom: tech lead to join the deep-dive and prepare notes on caching, quantization options (int8/int4), and whether we can hit sub-300ms tail for chat with Dedicated at their target concurrency.

Key constraints to keep in mind for pricing model: peak concurrency ~80, average chat length ~600 tokens, embeddings high QPS but low token length.

I plan to aim for a mid-range target around $90/1M tokens for their mixed profile (before reserved discounts). If you think that's unrealistic please call it out.

Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rios <alex.rios@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up (BrightLayer)

Alex — appreciate the numbers. Quick reply with next steps:

1) Confirmed we received the low/target/high volumes. Those ranges are workable. Based on initial sizing and the model mix you shared, we're preparing:
   - Pilot pricing (no commit): ~$140 / 1M tokens (hosted; higher due to burstable infra)
   - Mid (12mo modest commit): ~$90 / 1M tokens (recommended starting point for your target volumes)
   - Committed (24mo reserved Dedicated): ~$55 / 1M tokens (requires capacity commit and forecasting)

2) Proposed model mix (we'll validate in deep-dive): chat 70% token volume, embeddings 25% of calls (small token share), rerank 5% of calls. We adjusted slightly to match your token distribution.

3) Reserved capacity discounts typically scale with commit level and lead time; Rishi will send sliding discount bands and an example cost model by Monday.

4) Scheduling: can you do a technical deep-dive on Tue 2026-06-23 10am PT? We'll invite Priyom for quantization/caching discussion.

If procurement wants a formal term sheet we can provide a draft to accelerate approvals — let me know and we'll include standard security/compliance language (SOC2, data residency options).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference
